description: This file declares the GraphicBufferMapper class, which provides an interface for managing graphics buffers, including importing, freeing, locking, unlocking, and retrieving buffer metadata. It is part of the Android graphics system, specifically related to buffer mapping and gralloc integration.

classes.name: GraphicBufferMapper
classes.description: Singleton class providing buffer management functions such as import, free, lock, unlock, and metadata retrieval for graphics buffers.

methods.name: preloadHal
methods.description: Preloads hardware abstraction layer for gralloc.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of GraphicBufferMapper.

methods.name: dumpBuffer
methods.description: Dumps buffer information into a string.

methods.name: dumpBufferToSystemLog
methods.description: Logs buffer information to the system log.

methods.name: importBuffer
methods.description: Imports a buffer from a raw handle with specified parameters.

methods.name: getTransportSize
methods.description: Retrieves transport size information for a buffer.

methods.name: lockYCbCr
methods.description: Locks a buffer for YCbCr access.

methods.name: lockAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously locks a buffer for access.

methods.name: lockAsyncYCbCr
methods.description: Asynchronously locks a buffer for YCbCr access.

methods.name: isSupported
methods.description: Checks if a buffer configuration is supported.

methods.name: getLayerCount
methods.description: Retrieves the number of layers in the buffer.

methods.name: getPixelFormatFourCC
methods.description: Retrieves the pixel format FourCC code.

methods.name: getProtectedContent
methods.description: Checks if buffer contains protected content.

methods.name: getMapperVersion
methods.description: Returns the version of the mapper.
